About the Founder

A Sacred Initiative of Sanatana Dharma

Born from the sacred traditions of Shri Chakra Sahitha Rudra Mahakali – Shri Sarpaskanda Subrahmanya Mandir, Shri Om Tattva is dedicated to preserving the timeless wisdom and spiritual heritage of Sanatana Dharma. For generations, devotees have experienced the boundless grace of these Divine Deities — protection, prosperity, healing, courage and spiritual upliftment.

  • Authenticity — genuine and carefully selected sacred materials.
  • Sanctity — consecrated according to Vedic and Tantric traditions.
  • Devotion — offered with reverence at the Divine Feet before reaching you.

Acharya Rakshith Sharma

Dwi Vedanti · Agnihotra · Rudra Vachaspati
Mahant & Founder — Shri Om Tattva

A Vedic scholar, spiritual teacher and temple Mahant dedicated to preserving and sharing the sacred traditions of Sanatana Dharma. Under his guidance, every offering is prepared with devotion and consecrated according to traditional Vedic practices, carrying the blessings of Shri Rudra Mahakali and Shri Sarpaskanda Subrahmanya.

"May the Divine Grace of Shri Mahakali and Shri Kartikeya illuminate your life with protection, prosperity, wisdom and spiritual fulfilment."

Disclaimer

All products and sacred articles offered by Shri Om Tattva are traditional spiritual articles rooted in Indian cultural heritage and long-standing temple practices. They are offered as expressions of faith, devotion and tradition, and are intended solely for spiritual, ceremonial and personal devotional use.

Any references to traditional beliefs, customary practices, historical usage or scriptural significance are provided for informational and cultural purposes only. Individual experiences and beliefs may vary.

Shri Om Tattva does not make or imply any medical, therapeutic, scientific or guaranteed claims regarding any mala, bracelet, yantra, tabeez, kavacha, gemstone, herb or other sacred article. These products are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, prevent or mitigate any disease, illness, physical or mental health condition and should not be considered a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.

By purchasing or using any product from Shri Om Tattva, you acknowledge that it is being obtained for its spiritual, cultural and traditional significance and that its use is based on your personal faith and discretion.

Privacy Policy

Shri Om Tattva ("we", "us") collects the information you provide at checkout — name, phone number, email (optional), and delivery address — solely to process, dispatch and communicate about your order. We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.

Payment details are handled entirely by Razorpay, our payment partner; we do not store your card, UPI or netbanking credentials on our own systems. Order details may be shared with our courier partner solely for delivery purposes.

We also keep a first-party record of on-site activity — a randomly generated session identifier (not linked to your name unless you go on to place an order), which products were viewed and added to your basket, and whether a visit resulted in an order — to help us understand and improve the shopping experience. We do not use third-party advertising or tracking cookies.

For any privacy questions or to request deletion of your data, contact us using the email address in the footer below.

Terms & Conditions
  • All prices are listed in INR and are inclusive of applicable taxes unless stated otherwise.
  • Product images are representative; consecrated articles are handmade/natural and may show minor variation from the photo.
  • By placing an order you confirm the delivery details provided are accurate and that the articles are being purchased for lawful, personal, devotional use.
  • We reserve the right to cancel and refund any order we are unable to fulfil (e.g. stock unavailability).
Refund & Cancellation Policy

Orders can be cancelled free of charge before dispatch — message us on WhatsApp with your Order ID as soon as possible.

Once dispatched, we accept returns only for items received damaged or incorrect — contact us within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the item and packaging. Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5–7 business days of the returned item reaching us. Sacred articles that have been used/worn cannot be returned for reasons other than damage or a wrong item being sent.

Shipping Policy

Orders are consecrated, packed and dispatched from the Mandir within 2–3 working days. Delivery typically takes 3–7 days across India. Shipping is free above ₹999; a flat ₹79 shipping fee applies below that. International shipping timelines and charges are shared on WhatsApp after ordering.
